paragraphs.source_en: Kathryn sensed that there was a qualifier coming. And she was right. JR continued. “I’m just wondering if we need to continue having these off-sites now. Whatever sense of accomplishment that Kathryn had felt just a few minutes earlier had diminished significantly. As much as she wanted to put a quick and violent end to JR’s suggestion, Kathryn waited to see if anyone would do it for her.
